<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 198.99966 corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈197.992 Da. The formula C₈H₆O₄S matches this mass within a few millidaltons, making it the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H6O4S</final_answer>
